findings.rationale: Confirmed: finalize spawns check-redispatch-prompt.sh from --repo-root and opt-out reads the target repo resolver by default; shipped helpers must resolve from the driver/checker __dirname with env overrides only for tests (same rule R1 applied to dispatch-review.sh).
Confirmed against the checker test: a verified-Critical receipt is expected to pass. Gate must require recorded AND re-derived verdict SHIP-AS-IS; invert that expectation.

Confirmed: --allow-seat-gap lets an all-gap generation finalize into an empty-findings SHIP-AS-IS receipt with no trace. Receipt must record per-seat gap status and the checker must reject any generation with fewer than the configured minimum reviewed seats (default: all seats).

Confirmed: --plan-artifact mode validates no identity. It must require the canonical plan_review_artifact shape (artifact_type, logical_plan_id, generation, plan_sha256, rubric_sha256) and the disposition file identity to match, and verify plan/rubric digests against the files.

Confirmed: checker treats malformed/missing arrays as empty and does not compare receipt.chain to disk. Reuse the finalize validators (shared module) and fail on any malformed, duplicate, missing or extra record; exact chain equality.
Confirmed divergence: finalize closes-by-absence, checker accumulates all historical verified findings. One shared re-derivation routine used by both; closed_findings honoured identically.

Accepted with scope: keep replacing an aborted generation (that is the retry path and is recorded), but reject pending/pending-with-gap/finalized reuse, create generation directories exclusively, and require generation N finalized before N+1 collects.

Confirmed (with GLM finding on null verdicts): enforce a strict status/verdict/findings/proof matrix — SHIP-AS-IS accepts only the placeholder tokens none / n/a / no findings or parseable findings; any other non-empty unparseable text aborts; verdict null demotes to no_verdict; FIX-THEN-SHIP with empty findings is no_verdict.

Confirmed: exclusions are caller-chosen and blindly honoured. Bind --exclude to a frozen allowlist in the driver (platforms/**, profiles/*.json, docs/projects/**, docs/plans/evidence/**, docs/BACKLOG.md, lockfiles), record full-range and filtered digests, and have the checker reject exclusions outside the allowlist.

Accepted with scope: the plan keeps reviewer_* as the explicit hetero_review tuple, so auto need not replace a configured reviewer; but native fallback must overwrite the tuple with the documented native seat and schema-invalid topology entries must fall back, not be labelled topology.

Accepted with scope: use the scorecard row family when present instead of name heuristics; the chair stays reviewer-qualified per the frozen plan (consult rows are non-chair) — that part is refuted by the plan, the family part is verified.

Confirmed: the D3 prose was written before --phase-base became mandatory. collect generation 1 must persist the phase base (phase-

.base in the ledger) and dev-flow, hetero-review references and the L-4 gate line must pass --phase-base from it.
Confirmed: the hermetic test only drives the resolver. It must invoke scripts/dispatch-consult.sh with PATH-shimmed runners and assert the request/result while keeping the plugin-absent scratch HOME.
Confirmed; same repair as the parser matrix finding: null verdict is never reviewed; non-empty unparseable text aborts regardless of verdict except the placeholder tokens.
Confirmed: findings.json and seat artifacts are not hashed into the chain. collect records findings_sha256 and seat artifact shas; checker verifies before re-deriving.
Confirmed: deep-compare receipt.chain with the on-disk chain.json and drive validation from disk.
Confirmed fail-open on malformed open_findings; add the else branch that exits 1.
Confirmed: sync-version.js does not own the skills badge; both README badges still say 29. Update to 30 (skill-count-metadata test pins it).
Confirmed by design: the placeholder is replaced with this review chain result before merge; the checker gate and the pre-push qc-gate stand between here and develop.
CUT/FOLLOW-UP per the seat; alias normalisation in the consult picker is already a BACKLOG row (normalize_agy_alias exclusion mismatch).
